notes.title: Mighty Arms Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[h2]🛠️ [b]Mighty Arms Patch 1.1 is LIVE![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Patch 1.1 has landed, and the construction site is running smoother than ever.[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 [b]What’s Fixed in Patch 1.1:[/b][/p][p]⚡ [b]Generator task stabilized[/b] – The generators now receive damage appropriately and the enemies focus both equally. 
🏆 [b]Achievements unlock properly[/b] – There were some rare occurances where individual achievements were not unlocked. This is now fixed. 
🤖 [b]Enemy AI performance overhaul [/b]– Optimization in the enemies code has bettere performance [/p][p]💥 [b]General performance[/b] - Performance polish applied.[/p]
